name: memoria castaway
source:
Memoria Castaway is a point-and-click visual novel with fishing minigames. Follow our protagonist as they fish their way through their memories and, for better or worse, remember why they forgot them in the first place.

[From [url=https://ethverie.itch.io/memoria-castaway]itch.io[/url]]
translation:
Memoria Castaway是一款带有钓鱼小游戏的点击式视觉小说。跟随我们的主角在他们的记忆中摸索，无论好坏，记住他们最初忘记这些记忆的原因。

[来自[url=https://ethverie.itch.io/memoria-castaway]itch.io[/url]]
